slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain that builds as you run
A change in how you walk

caption:
Toto swapped the footpath for the beach, ran a slow 5 km, and woke up with stiff calves.

On soft sand your foot sinks and slides with every step, so your calves, Achilles and feet do far more work to push off. Your pace drops, but the load climbs.

Start with five to ten minutes of soft sand inside your usual run and add a few minutes each week. Firm sand near the water is a handy middle step, and running out and back evens out the slope.

Achilles or calf pain that builds during runs, or a sudden pop, is worth getting assessed. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
